Hybrid and EV repair in Shah Alam

Hybrid EV workshop in Shah Alam for high-voltage batteries, electric drive and control modules.

High-voltage battery work

We have replaced hybrid high-voltage batteries on the Volvo XC90 and XC60 T8, the BMW X5 F15, 45e and G05, and the Mercedes S400 hybrid. Volvo hybrid battery jobs in Shah Alam are some of our most common posts.

Electric drive and modules

We replace electric rear-axle (ERAD) motors and repair and program IGM, IEM, EME and DCDC modules, plus onboard chargers and coolant pumps.

Diagnostics first

Every new energy vehicle job starts with a scan of the high-voltage system and the control modules, so we fix the cause and not only the warning.

Questions

Do you replace Volvo T8 hybrid batteries?

Yes. We have done high-voltage battery work on the Volvo XC90 T8 and XC60 T8 in our Shah Alam bay.

Can you repair an EME or DCDC module?

Yes. We repair and program IGM, IEM, EME and DCDC modules. WhatsApp us the model, year and the fault message.
